Lines 293–297 use `IsUnit.smul_mem_nhds_smul_iff`, whose Mathlib declaration is under `ContinuousConstSMul`.

findings.issue: `isOpen_idealImage`, `openAddSubgroup`, and `isBounded_ringOfDefinition` unnecessarily require `[IsTopologicalRing A]`; the Tate lemmas at lines 293 and 306 likewise need only continuity of constant multiplication.

summary: Several pair-level and pseudouniformiser results retain a stronger topological-ring assumption than their statements require.
